# Acme Marketplace Tools

Skills for running the Acme team plugin marketplace.

## Install

**Claude Code**
```

/plugin install acme-marketplace-tools@acme-plugin-marketplace
```

**Codex**
```
codex plugin marketplace add acme/acme-plugin-marketplace
```
